tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// phyugs nad gnag nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ dhan dha ba ti/ bod skad du/ phyugs nad gnag nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ lha mo parna sha ba ri la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ni phyugs kyi lha yin te/ phyugs ma rnams la gnod byed bsrung bar mdzod/ phyugs la gnod byed thams cad ni// skad cig tsam gyis rdul du rlog /rgod nad drag po myur du zlog /sngags rgod 'dis ni phyugs nad thams cad gcod// de'i sngags ni 'di dag ste/ tad+ya thā/ hū ri ma thā rbad chod/ thun bh+yoḥswā hā/ pad+ma ha ya gh+ri wa sarba sa ma ya/ dzā dza/ ru lu re ma ti/ bh+yo dza dza rbad rbad nān swā hā/ gdon gegs log 'dren thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ oṃ parna sha ba ri sho rtse raṃ/ phyugs la gnod par byed pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /gnag la nad rigs gla yor dang*/ rgyu yor dang*/ lhog rims rnag nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭhā badz+ra ye swā hā/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ni ta ya/ bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// bong phyugs 'di rnams la glo dang rgyu nad lag nad dang*/ rkang nad byung ba 'di rnams zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra ha la ha la/ hi li hi li/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sarba swā hā/ oṃ na laṃ bha re rdo ra da/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa// bong bu 'di yi nad gdon 'di rnams las srungs shig /bong phyugs 'di rnams kyi nad gdon rnam rtog ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /rkang bzhi phyugs bong 'di rnams la nad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi phyugs rnams spel cig /dpal phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bong bu'i gzungs mdo rdzogs so/// /bkra shis/// /
